entries.remark: The electric field inside a cavity of a conductor is zero. This protects sensitive instruments from external electrical noise. This is why it is safe to sit inside a car during lightning.
Work done per unit test charge in bringing it from infinity to a point. Scalar quantity.
The ability of a system to store charge. Unit is Farad (F).
